outcome: Cord arterial blood pH and lactate
cohort: Women undergoing caesarean birth at full cervical dilatation
finding: There was no evidence that use of the Fetal Pillow during caesarean birth at full cervical dilatation was associated with a reduced rate of adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The study found no evidence that using the Fetal Pillow to elevate an impacted fetal head during cesarean birth at full cervical dilatation reduced adverse maternal or neonatal outcomes.
